scope: Backend bearer-session ownership, logout isolation, TTL source, JSON field casing, and this QA browser/profile metadata only.

conclusion.logout_scope: STATIC: /api/logout is behind withAuth; handler extracts the request Bearer and calls auth.Manager.Logout(token). Logout deletes only that exact token key from Manager.sessions; there is no per-user/session-wide deletion in this path.
conclusion.login_effect: STATIC: Login creates a fresh UUID token and inserts one map entry. It does not iterate over sessions or revoke earlier sessions for the same user. SSOLogin uses the same independent-token insertion pattern.
conclusion.persistence: STATIC: auth.Manager stores bearer sessions in an in-memory map; no user-session persistence store was found in the reviewed auth implementation. This is distinct from internal/hub/session.go Agent connection tracking.
conclusion.ttl_source: STATIC: DefaultConfig sets 24h; an optional YAML config can override session_ttl; applyEnv contains no session-TTL override; cfg.SessionTTL is passed to auth.New. The active Hub effective config was not read, and this QA metadata does not contain Session.Expires, so current effective TTL remains unknown.
conclusion.role_and_token_shape: STATIC: /api/login wraps the session as lowercase outer key token and user; Session exported fields serialize with Go-default uppercase Token/UserID/Username/Role/Expires, except Avatar tagged lowercase. /api/me returns Session directly. Frontend SessionInfo and sessionToUser consume Role/UserID/Username/Expires uppercase. Persist the outer login token before origin localStorage injection; do not infer a lowercase Role field.
conclusion.unrelated_web_401: No causal link can be established between the previously observed Web profile /me 401 and this QA session. Our evidence covers only our dedicated session and browser profile.

source_refs.fact: Session JSON shape: exported fields default to uppercase names; only Avatar has a lowercase tag.
Manager owns in-memory map keyed by token; default TTL is supplied by constructor.
Login verifies user, generates UUID, assigns Expires from sessionTTL and inserts a fresh token key; no existing-session invalidation.
Authenticate checks per-token expiry; Logout deletes the exact token key.
SSOLogin also generates and inserts a distinct token; no per-user invalidation.
/api/logout and /api/me both use bearer auth middleware.
withAuth authenticates the provided bearer before invoking the route.
Bearer token is taken from Authorization: Bearer ...
Login returns lowercase token/user wrapper; logout deletes extracted token; /me returns Session directly.
Config YAML session_ttl field and 24h default.
YAML config is unmarshaled, environment overrides applied, then SessionTTL is passed to Hub.
applyEnv does not define NODESTEER_SESSION_TTL or another TTL override.
Frontend SessionInfo expects uppercase Role/UserID/Username/Expires, with lowercase avatar.
Frontend takes result.token from lowercase login wrapper before setting user from result.user.
SessionManager is a separate in-memory Agent connection map keyed by nodeID, not the bearer-token map in auth.Manager.

uncertainties: The actual Hub active configuration file and effective session_ttl were not inspected, so the live effective TTL is unknown.
No second-user or shared-session probe was run; non-interference with other tokens is a static code conclusion only.
The earlier Web profile 401 is not attributed to this QA session.
